title: He started running at 70 to carry his daughter's memory. At 74 he ran three marathons in a fortnight.

posts.facebook:
Retired headteacher Mike Barnes started running at 70. This spring, at 74, he ran Brighton, Manchester and London in about two weeks.

Mike Barnes started running at 70 after losing his daughter Laura to bowel cancer. Now 74, he has run four marathons, raised around £45,000 for Bowel Cancer UK and ran London 2026 alongside his two other daughters.

A purpose bigger than yourself — a cause, a person — can carry you through the first hard months of a new sport.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/move/mike-barnes-three-marathons-74/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
